method.phase_definition: episode_time_s <= 2.0 initialization; > 2.0 steady, at every reset
method.planar_speed: hypot(vx,vy), root COM velocity in body frame
method.displacement: root-link XY first-to-last sampled pose within each episode/phase; no cross-reset sums
method.contact: rigid-body net force history peak; pair identity unavailable
method.duration: 6000*0.01=60 cumulative simulation seconds, with original 20s timeout resets
method.provisional_targets: steady MAE<=5mm and P95<=10mm; separately mean planar speed<=0.02m/s
method.usd: fresh run-local conversion; no external USD seed
